items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: The mention of Connie Francis occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn. The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention, nor does he mention Connie Francis in his own turns.

ctx.x: Perfect. I played — really, playing a dog act and playing some chords. You know play “Saints Go Marching In” or something.

That’s a whole part of musicianship that you have to learn on the job. I remember playing for Connie Francis once and they had the music on this one particular page with black marker was all covered up. In red marker it said, “Play all of this.” So you’re going what’s the right thing to do here, and you just have to like pay attention. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

Well I’ll give you an experience like that. When I joined Harry James we were in Vegas with Phil Harris. And so we were playing the same thing every night, right? Then we went out on the road and the trumpet player before me was bugged, he got fired, which you know a lot of guys did before, because they did something, I don’t know. And this guy took the book and in those days it wasn’t a condensed book like I carry now, because it was the whole Harry James library on each side you had that much music, right? You…
